args: Title screen: white text on light blue (115,166,230) has contrast ~2.5:1, below WCAG 4.5:1 for the small 'Press any key or click to continue' line.
Main menu: buttons (approx #5BA0EE) barely differ from the background (#73A6E6), button edges nearly invisible; small white labels ~2.5:1 contrast.

Config screen: 'Chunk Size', 'Location Scale', 'Lag Prevention', 'Respawn Pawns' have no explanation, not even on hover (no tooltips). Volume label says '(sound plays in the browser version)', implying desktop has no sound, yet offers Volume and Mute. Hovered Lag Prevention: checkbox highlight barely visible.
Controls p2: 'Era box (tap)' uses touch wording on desktop; a mouse player would expect 'click'. Also doesn't say where the Era box is. Controls screens otherwise readable (good contrast).

HUD: 'Energy 84' label is white on bright green bar (64,179,77) ~2.7:1 contrast; 'Create Nation'/'Join Nation' buttons white on teal ~4.0:1 (below 4.5). Era box shows 'Era: Camp (1/4) +' and 'Village: 0/4' with a yellow square, neither explained on screen (what is 0/4? what does + do?).

Era box expanded (click): header 'Village: 0/4' means 0 of 4 requirements met, but right below the checklist says 'Village 0/1' (settlements) — reads like two contradicting village counts. 'Day 1/3' here vs Season panel 'day 1/2' uses 'day' for two different things. Hovered Era button is white text on bright blue (66,150,250), ~3:1. '+'/'-' expander glyph is the only hint the box is clickable.

First chop: status line says 'Gathered 5 wood and 3 apples from tree.' but floating text says '+2 apples' and inventory gets Apples: 2 (energy jumped 80->95, so presumably one was eaten automatically, but nothing on screen says so). '+2 saplings' floating text is pale on the bright lime tree canopy, hard to read. Tip changes to 'Gather stone' while objective is still 'Gather wood 5/10'.

Objective 1 'Gather wood' complete toast was replaced after ~1 s (52 ticks) by objective 2 'Eat something' completing on its own, which the player never did on purpose (apples seem to be auto-eaten). The first toast is effectively unreadable. Chronicle lines are cut off with '...' at panel width ('Upper...', 'Gr...') with no hover or wider view except pressing Y. In chop2b the floating '+2 apples' passes BEHIND the translucent Chronicle panel.

On bright lime grass (midday, Plains) the translucent panels wash out: bottom action buttons 'Leave Nation / Found Settlement / Plant Sapling' white on (105,195,147) = 2.1:1; objective progress 'Wood 50/50' white on yellow bar (230,179,0) = 1.9:1; Objective hint text grey on (65,105,43) = 4.0:1; Chronicle header '[Y: more]' grey on green is the faintest text on screen. Inventory/Season/Player panels are opaque and fine (17:1). Also 'Too close to another settlement.' gives no distance or direction to move.

Share screen: 'Export replay (USD)' — 'USD' reads as US dollars to most players; the 3D file format (OpenUSD) is not explained, no hover help. Pause/Share text ('World seed', URL) is drawn straight over the 3D scene with no backing panel; here the player capsule sits behind the URL line, lowering its contrast.

Inventory screen (I): item lines are drawn directly over the 3D world with no panel; the player capsule sits right behind 'Apples: 21' / 'Saplings: 7', so white text sits on a dark-blue/white shaded shape. Screen shows nothing the HUD Inventory box doesn't already, and offers no way to eat/use an item.

Crafting screen: a stale, unrelated status 'Too close to another settlement.' is shown at the bottom (left over from pressing F in the world). Nothing says HOW to craft (click the row? key?) — no Craft button, rows don't react to hover while unaffordable. Subtitle line 'Out in the world: ... with a Workshop' lacks a final period and spans almost the whole window. Grey detail lines (e.g. '+3 wood per tree, lasts 20 trees') are small, dim text.

Nations screen (O): no hover help on Tribute/Ally/War/Denounce; 'Denounce' and 'War' consequences are never explained. The '(0)' after 'Neutral' is an unlabelled relation score; header says 'Tribute 25 coins for +10 ... alliance needs +30' — +10 of what? Ally buttons look identical (enabled) even though every relation is 0 < 30. Stale status 'Too close to another settlement.' shows here too. Window-wide text drawn over the 3D world; tab buttons translucent with a tree showing through 'Laws'.

Laws tab: only the CURRENT option is described ('No tax: members keep their coin'); what Low/High, Conscription On, Borders Open do is not shown anywhere, not even on hover. 'Defence 1.' is unexplained. Selected option is marked only by '> None <' ASCII brackets, buttons otherwise identical colour. Stale 'Too close to another settlement.' still shown.

Standing at my new settlement: the world-space settlement label is drawn huge (~45px glyphs), clipped off the top of the window ('...0 here, 0/8 residents' — the name line is cut off entirely) and it collides with the status bar, Chronicle panel and Era box. Bottom action buttons ('Leave Nation', 'Teleport Home', 'Plant Sapling', 'Enter Settlement') are white on pale blue-grey over sand: ~1.9:1. Founding feedback 'You raised...' status was immediately overwritten by 'You are back on your own land.'

Inside settlement (default 960x540): right column overflows. (1) Settlement Info 'Next (K): Farm, 25 wood, 10...' cut off at the right edge, cost unreadable. (2) Season panel is pushed down to y~432 and overlaps the Player Info panel: 'LEADER' and 'Land: your own land' bleed out from behind it, and Season's last line 'stone' touches the window bottom. (3) The bottom action-button row runs under the right column: the 6th button shows only 'Se' (probably 'Sell ...'). (4) 'PCIS: 2' is unexplained jargon. (5) green triangles after market prices have no legend. (6) 'Purchase Food' etc. buttons white on teal ~4:1.

Objective 7 progress bar label is clipped on the left: shows 'nbers 6/10 • Buildings 0/2' (should be 'Members 6/10 · Buildings 0/2') — the centred text is wider than the 182px bar. Pawn nameplates (e.g. 'Rachel Jones / Loyal, Glutton / (doing nothing)', top right) are ~6px tall, unreadable. Objective 6 'Build a market stall' completed by itself at tick 7503 while I had Wood 10/20, Stone 0/5 and never pressed B; nothing on screen said who built it. While inside a settlement W/S did not move me (walkto timed out) and no text says movement is locked until you Exit.
Tip 'Your goals' says 'your era (tap it to see what the next one needs)' — touch wording on desktop; should be 'click it'.

Chronicle full history (Y): the window background is translucent, so the Tip card text ('are at the top left: your era (tap it to...') and the Season/Player panels show through behind the list rows — text-on-text overlap around rows 'Samantha Watson...' to 'Tilly Thomas...'. 'Only my nation' checkbox is a dark square on dark blue, barely visible. Lines are coloured yellow only for own-nation events with no legend (the '*' prefix is the only cue).

Pressing R next to three pawns (2.3m, 5.4m) says '! There is no one within reach to invite.' — they are presumably already members of my nation, but the message claims nobody is there. Expected: 'Grace Roberts is already in Bigshire.' Objective hint 'Befriend settlers and press R' doesn't say how to befriend (G = gift is only in Controls).

Load screen: 'Delete' sits right next to the save row in the same blue as 'Load' — no danger colour, no hint whether it asks for confirmation. Save row shows only 'Day 1 - Bigshire' + date, not the seed.
